column1: # THE TRINIDAD, FLORES KINDRED - SWEPT ON FAMILYSEARCH, 27 September 2026.
# *** WHY THIS EXISTS. *** The same morning, all 33 findmypast transcripts for "Uruguay Baptisms
# 1750-1900" were opened and gave 20 children across 14 households. A single FamilySearch search on
# BIRTHPLACE = Trinidad, Flores returned a generation findmypast does not hold at all - the CHILDREN
# of the children. *** ONE INDEX IS NOT ANOTHER INDEX, AND NEITHER IS THE PARISH BOOK. ***
# *** THE FINDING THAT CLOSES A STORY: CUSTODIO AND EMA MARRIED. *** data/1911-lerena-cardozo-dispensation.tsv
# holds the priest's two kinship diagrams for CUSTODIO LERENA and EMA CARDOZO, double first cousins,
# seeking dispensation in 1911. This archive has never known whether it was granted. *** THEIR DAUGHTER
# VIOLETA BLANCA WAS BORN 29 OCTOBER 1915 AND CHRISTENED AT TRINIDAD ON 16 SEPTEMBER 1916. *** It was.
# *** AND THE 1726 ARTEFACT IS HERE AGAIN. *** Lauriana Lerena, christened 1891, is indexed with
# "Birth 12 September 1726" - the collection's first year standing in for a date it does not have. This
# archive documented that trap on /method/; it is not a date and it is not evidence.
# TIER: *** INDEX ONLY. NO IMAGE WAS OPENED FOR ANY ROW BELOW. *** Several names are visibly mangled -
# "Min Levena Fer" is FERMIN LERENA, "Capas-Ra Pelaes" is CASIMIRA PELAEZ, "Isaac Lerera" is ISAAC
# LERENA, "Juan Bernardo Serena" is the S-for-L again. This file is a POINTER TO PLATES, not a finding.
# NOT EXHAUSTIVE: this is the first page of one search. The sweep is a work-list row, not a closed job.

column6: *** THE 1911 DISPENSATION WAS GRANTED AND THE COUSINS MARRIED. *** The single most useful row here.
Juan Bernardo, b.1871, Bernabe and Casimira's son, is married and a father. A PELAEZ again.
A SECOND child for the Fermin x Barragan household, which findmypast showed with one.
A third child for Cipriano, named for her mother.
The next generation marrying CARDOZO - the surname of the 1911 dispensation.
FLORENCIO is one of the six or seven Trinidad fathers this archive names.
*** TWO RECUERO WIVES, OR ONE WOMAN INDEXED TWICE: NOT ESTABLISHED. ***
Another Alejandro, and a FIFTH one for data/the-three-alejandros.tsv to watch.
A FOURTH Lerena woman recorded as a mother with no father named.
Found in the burial control search; a child of the Trinidad Alejandro this archive did not hold.
